update.notes: ver1.1.26 - Dong ho RPM/SPEED: bo nen phu toan mat, chi giu nen vach chia va vong trong chua so. - Thu nho va ha tieu de RPM/SPEED cho can doi. - Giu nguyen HP/TOQ/AFR, cau hinh JSON va RUN. - AFR: khoi phuc luoi chinh, giam vach chia, hover hien ten RUN / truc X / AFR. - Menu active chi doi icon va chu cyan, nen/vien giu mac dinh. - Doi AFR TARGET cap nhat ngay duong muc tieu va gia tri tren chart. - Checkbox HP/TOQ/AFR moi, can deu o tick va chu. - Luoi AFR dung chung cach ve luoi Dyno. - Them net vong manh ngoai vach chia RPM/SPEED; vach TORQUE cung mau cam. - Tang nhe vong trong dong ho; so dai tu can vua vong, khong doi gia tri RPM/SPEED.
